Anne Marie barge Review

Review of Anne Marie barge

The Anne-Marie barge cruises in Provence and Burgundy (along the Canal de Provence, France), departing from the homeports of Sète (on the French Riviera) and Arles. These are one-way itineraries operated exclusively during the summer months.

MS Anne-Marie is owned by CroisiEurope and operates canal cruises in France alongside her luxury hotel barge fleetmates Daniele, Deborah, Jeanine, Madeleine, and Raymonde. This new ship, built in 2014, is among the most luxurious hotel barges currently operating in France.

Cabins

The CroisiEurope hotel barge Anne-Marie has only 12 passenger cabins, each equally sized at 97 ft² (9 m²) and featuring a picture window. Amenities include a private bathroom (with WC, sink, and shower), flat-screen TV, radio, telephone (internal calls only), hairdryer, personal safe, and individual air-conditioning.

Shipboard Facilities

Onboard amenities include a lounge with a bar, a restaurant, a sundeck relaxation area with loungers and parasols, a barbecue area, a prow-located Jacuzzi, complimentary bicycles, and free Wi-Fi Internet access.

Anne-Marie's Provence canal cruise itinerary follows the Rhône River canals along the Avignon-Sète route, stopping in picturesque villages and rural areas. Guests enjoy gourmet dining on board and can participate in food and wine sampling events featuring local cuisine and regional wines. Optional excursions include:

  • Étang de Thau (food tasting and oyster farms)
  • Sète (island tour)
  • Aigues-Mortes (guided tour and salt marshes)
  • Camargue and Arles (city tours)

CroisiEurope also owns and operates in France the cruise barges Deborah, Jeanine, Madeleine, and Raymonde.

MS Anne-Marie barge cruise prices are per person and based on double occupancy. These are indicative CroisiEurope rates and may vary depending on travel agency promotions, special offers, group bookings, or last-minute deals. CroisiEurope barge cruises in France include all beverages (coffee, tea, juices, soft drinks, wine, and beer at lunch and dinner), but shore excursions are optional and available at an additional cost.

Anne Marie barge Wiki

CroisiEurope's Anne-Marie barge is often described as one of the most innovative hotel barges cruising in France. The vessel features two decks with just 12 cabins (each 12 m², including a private bathroom), offering accommodations comparable to other riverboats in Europe. A highlight of the Anne-Marie barge cruises is the complimentary use of onboard bicycles for shore excursions at each port of call along the itinerary.

The CroisiEurope cruise company is a family-owned business based in Strasbourg, France. Established in 1976, this premium line manages all aspects of its cruises in-house, from vessel design and construction to cuisine and hotel services. CroisiEurope is one of the largest cruise operators in Europe.

CroisiEurope river cruise deals include soft drinks and alcohol (wine and beer with lunch and dinner) year-round. During the high season in Europe (April through October), the line offers packages with unlimited drinks. However, unlike most river cruise lines, CroisiEurope charges additionally for shore excursions.

The Anne-Marie barge cruises through Provence and Burgundy (southeastern and east-central France), navigating the Rhône River canals along the wine route from Avignon to Sète. The itinerary includes stops in charming villages, allowing guests to sample local wines and traditional French cuisine.

In addition to Anne-Marie, CroisiEurope also owns and operates the French cruise barges Daniele, Deborah, Jeanine, Madeleine, and Raymonde.

Other CroisiEurope ships operating on the Saône and Rhône rivers include Camargue, Mistral, and Van Gogh.
